buildCommand: export RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/.rustup CARGO_HOME=/tmp/.cargo PATH=/tmp/.cargo/bin:$PATH && curl -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --no-modify-path --default-toolchain stable && rustup target add wasm32-unknown-unknown && curl -sSfL https://github.com/trunk-rs/trunk/releases/latest/download/trunk-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | tar -xz -C /tmp/.cargo/bin && trunk build --release

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https://i.ytimg.com https://*.googleusercontent.com; frame-src https://www.youtube.com; connect-src 'self' https://www.googleapis.com; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none';
